title: Iowa AI Laws

reading.body:
Iowa's only AI-related law governs health insurance prior authorization, not AI development, data centers, or compute.

The pattern is narrow. HF2635 regulates health carriers and utilization review organizations, and its AI provision is a prohibition: artificial intelligence cannot be the sole basis to deny, delay, or downgrade a medical necessity prior authorization. The law also sets audit and peer review timelines, exempts certain cancer screenings and emergency conditions from prior authorization, updates certificate of need thresholds, and is enforced through the insurance commissioner. It passed on 2026-05-13 and takes effect 07/01/2026.

For AI specifically, this is a decision-accountability rule rather than a capability rule. It does not restrict model training, deployment, or the physical infrastructure AI runs on. It places a human or non-AI check in one high-stakes decision path, which matters because prior authorization is exactly the kind of automated denial that generates political pressure for broader AI regulation. If that pressure spreads, it would land on insurers and reviewers, not on the power and buildings that constrain AI scaling.

What this does not tell the reader: whether Iowa will regulate AI anywhere else. A single law in one sector says nothing about the state's posture toward data centers, grid interconnection, or AI in employment, policing, or elections. The count of one is a fact about enacted text this site tracks, not a measure of AI activity in the state.

Iowa has enacted 1 AI-related law. Each is read from its enrolled text: what it does, who it applies to, when it takes effect, and what it requires.

Enacted AI laws in Iowa

1 law this site judged relevant to AI, newest first, each read from its enrolled text.

  • HF2635: A bill for an act relating to health carriers standards of conduct; utilization review organizations, artificial intelligence, audits, and prior authorizations; certificate of need processes; and including applicability provisions. (Formerly HF 2438.) Effective date: 07/01/2026. passed 2026-05-13

    This Iowa law regulates health carriers and utilization review organizations in prior authorization, audits, artificial intelligence use, and provider standards of conduct. It prohibits using artificial intelligence as the sole basis to deny, delay, or downgrade medical necessity prior authorizations, sets audit and peer review timelines, and exempts certain cancer screenings and emergency conditions from prior authorization. It also updates certificate of need thresholds and exemptions and provides enforcement through the insurance commissioner.

How this page is kept

This page is generated from the enacted laws this site tracks for Iowa. When the legislature passes another AI-related bill, it appears here the night the bill's text is read. The full 50-state picture is at State AI Laws.
